summary: Miluna Acquisition Corp, a SPAC, entered a definitive Business Combination Agreement with Kukugan Invest and CADV Ventures S.A. The blank-check company will merge with Parent, making the Company a wholly-owned subsidiary. The transaction has an aggregate value of $250 million. The deal was unanimously approved by Miluna's board based on a special committee recommendation, and also by the boards and sole shareholder of the other parties. Closing is expected in the second half of 2026, subject to Miluna shareholder approval and other conditions. Watch for shareholder vote timing and any redemption risk; arbitrage focuses on the de-SPAC completion.
